title: Claims and evidence for reused data-derived patient labels: a specification, a survey of sepsis partitions, and a worked example: analysis code
description: Code-only research software for a claim-specific specification illustrated with one sepsis partition. Includes post hoc temperature-source correction, Base + K2 updating, verified reconstruction and corrected-temperature external evaluation of Raw-EN/Raw-RF using the archived L2 recipe, current paired comparisons, held-out recalibration, hospital funnel and missing-pattern transfer. This patch synchronizes the Figure 3 and Figure 5 renderers with the final submission layout and updates seven-author citation metadata; statistical calculations and inputs are unchanged. Restricted data, fitted objects, result tables, figure datasets, execution logs and literature-survey materials are excluded.
